book.name: 2 Timotius
book.title: 2 Timotius Paulus susura kadua na fee nonoon Timotius

content: Mu tui-beka Manetualain Hara-dasin

Neuꞌ ko Yesus Kristus natafali leo dae-bafoꞌ ia mai, fo homu pareta sama leoꞌ maneꞌ. Leo mae lahenda fo bei nasoda, ma lahenda fo mate si so, basa si reu rataa Ni fo Ana naetuꞌ sira dedea nara. De, au hule tebe-tebe nai Manetualain no Yesus Kristus matan, fo mu tui-beka fee lahenda ra, Manetualain Hara-dasin. Sadia laꞌo maroo! Bosoꞌ afi mae ledo-fain malole a do taꞌa. Matudu lahenda salan. Ma masaꞌai si no malole ma dale naneneteꞌ. Matetea dale nara pake nanori roo-tetuꞌ a.
Huu fo balahaa-binesaꞌ, lahenda ta nau ramanene nanori matetuꞌ a soꞌ. Ara rahiiꞌ ramanene noi mesen fo tutui nara naraa laꞌe no sira ridoo namanene nara.
Ara ta nau ramanene nanori matetuꞌ a. Tehuu rahiiꞌ ramanene noi tutui papake taꞌ ara!

Leo mae leoꞌ bea boe, o muste balaroe-balanau aom. Manenete nai doidoso daleꞌ. Mu tui-beka Tutui Malole a ela lahenda ra sipoꞌ Yesus Kristus. Malalau lahenda no dale namahoꞌo, losaꞌ basa nonoi-tataoꞌ ria. Bosoꞌ moi no dale poseseriꞌ.
Bosoꞌ tao aafiꞌ neu au, huu fo au fai mamate ka naneneaꞌ so. Au ia sama leoꞌ galaas a, isi na sakaꞌ basa ni so.
Tehuu au apoꞌilalaiꞌ basa no malole. Au alai losa too a so. Au tuka ahere Yesus Kristus, ma ta heo leo baiꞌ u boeꞌ.

Besaꞌ ia, bei ahani noi hata esa. Riꞌ beker pareis fo ita Ramatua na peda memaꞌ ana fee basa lahenda fo rasoda no roo-tetuꞌ. Ita Ramatua na nana manaꞌee dedea matetuꞌ. Neuꞌ ko naraa no ledo-fai na, Ana fee au beker pareis ria. Ma ta noi au mesaꞌ ka. Tehuu basa lahenda fo sue-lai neuꞌ Ana, ma rahani mamai Na, sira hapu beker leo naꞌ boe!
Paulus fee hehelu rupaꞌ ara
Timotius! O lai-lai mai dama au dei!

Huu fo besaꞌ ia, au mesaꞌ ka. Kreskes leo propinsi Galatia neu so. Ma Titus boe leo nusa Dalmatia neu so. Tehuu Demas nahiiꞌ noi hata dae-bafo papake taꞌ ia, ana foa ela au de leo kota Tesalonika neu so.
Noi Lukas mesaꞌ ana leo no au nai ia. Saka ma Markus, fo emi dua mai belaꞌ a. Huu fo ana bisa tulu-fali rupaꞌ ara neuꞌ au nai ia.
Au fee Tikikus leo kota Efesus neu so.
Maneniko o mai sona, mafarereneꞌ muni au jeket ka fo au laꞌo elan nai Karpus uma na nai kota Troas. Ma mafarereneꞌ muni au susura kara, lena-lenaꞌ manaduiꞌ nai banda rouꞌ a.
Alexander manatutu riti ria, ana tao tadaluꞌ dodouꞌ neuꞌ au so. Pesin nemeꞌ na, huu fo neuꞌ ko Ramatuaꞌ a balas ana, tuka ria nonoi-tataon.
Besa-besa mo lahenda ria, nana huu ana nahiiꞌ nalena laka ita dedea-nafadan.

Tepoꞌ fo au masososa apadei nai manaꞌee dedeaꞌ ara matan fo asalaꞌe au dedea ka, ta hapu lahenda esa sama-sama no au boeꞌ. Basa si laoꞌ ela au. Nemeꞌ na! Ela Manetualain nafarene heni sira sala-siko nara.

Leoꞌ mae leo naꞌ boe, tehuu Manetualain ta foa ela au fa. Ana fee bebeꞌi-baraꞌaiꞌ neuꞌ au, ela au bisa tui-beka Tutui Malole Na ma ta kura-kaiꞌ hata esa boeꞌ. Au tui-beka leoꞌ na neuꞌ basa lahenda fo ta Yahudi fa, ela ramanene Tutui Malole ria. Ma au boe poꞌi a ao ka emeꞌ mamates a mai.

Neuꞌ ko Manetualain poꞌi na au eme basa tadaluꞌ ara mai. Ma Ana napipipi-nalalaꞌo au no soda-moleꞌ, masoꞌ leo nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a u. Ria riꞌ homu pareta a nai na. Manetualain marela-masaꞌa! Au io-oa ma soꞌu amadedema Ni, ta namaetun! Amin.
Paulus duiꞌ nateꞌe susura na
Bosoꞌ mafarene henin fee haraoe soda-moleꞌ neuꞌ susi Priskila,
no saon, bu Akila. Leoꞌ na boe neuꞌ Onesiforus kileoboboki nara katemaꞌ.
Erastus leo nai kota Korintus. Fai maꞌulu na au foa ela Trofimus nai kota Miletus, huu fo tepoꞌ ria ana namahedi beraꞌ.
Malale fo beita losa fai oefaaꞌ a, te o losa nai ia so. Toraranoo Ebulus, Pudes, Linus ma susi Klaudia ma toranoo kamahere fekeꞌ fo rai ia, sira basa raruꞌu-ralosaꞌ haraoe soda-moleꞌ fee emi.
Au hule fo Manetualain sama-sama no o losa do-doo na neu. Ma Ana natudu dale malole Na neuꞌ emi basa.

footnotes.text: Tepoꞌ fo lahenda Yahudi ra tao tutunu-hohotuꞌ nai Uma Mamaso Ina a, hapu tutunu-hohotuꞌ rupaꞌ esa fo muste poꞌa oe anggor neuꞌ mei tutunu-hohotuꞌ a lain. Batee Paulus fee nasasamaꞌ nae, ria masoda na sama leoꞌ oe anggor fo sakaꞌ poꞌa basan, ela dadi tutunu-hohotuꞌ fee Manetualain.
Dedea Yunani nai ia manaduiꞌ nae, ‘Priska’. Priska no Priskila, nana nadeꞌ dua tehuu lahenda esa.
